issue_context.title: Kubernetes CLI commands are still implemented in Core
issue_context.body:
### Body

The CLI commands provided by `cncf.kubernetes` provider are still implemented in `airlfow.cli.kubernetes`. While we cannot fully remove them from Airflow for back-compatibility with old provider versions, we should move them to k8S similarly as we did for `celery` (leaving the old implementation in core for old providers).

### Committer

- [X] I acknowledge that I am a maintainer/committer of the Apache Airflow project.

review_comments: Does this mean that logic should be maintained in both files until deprecation? Is there a way to avoid duplication?

Like @potiuk said in the description of the issue
> leaving the old implementation in core for old providers

Yeah. We might decide in the future that we do not allow older provider versions (we can check it at runtime - similarly to what we propose to do for openlineage in https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/39513#discussion_r1596005178 - and then we will be able to remove it from the core. But that is something maybe in a year or two.
